blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of rotating draft beers and purchase beer to go in cans and crowlers. The taproom offers made-from-scratch food with gluten-free options and daily specials. Burnish Beer Co. hosts events, large parties, fundraisers, and vendor events with reservation options for groups.
